# MockHub API — llms.txt
# Secondary concert ticket marketplace

> MockHub is a secondary ticket marketplace for concerts, sports, theater, comedy, and festivals.
> This file describes the public API for AI agents.

## Base URL
/api/v1

## Authentication
POST /api/v1/auth/login — JSON body: {"email", "password"} → {"accessToken", "expiresIn", "user"}
POST /api/v1/auth/register — JSON body: {"email", "password", "firstName", "lastName", "phone"} → {"accessToken", "expiresIn", "user"}
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh — Refresh access token via HttpOnly cookie
GET /api/v1/auth/me — Get current user profile
PUT /api/v1/auth/me — Update profile. JSON body: {"firstName", "lastName", "phone"}
POST /api/v1/auth/oauth2/exchange?code={code} — Exchange OAuth2 one-time code for JWT. Code is a query parameter, not a JSON body.
GET /api/v1/auth/me/providers — List linked OAuth providers for current user
OAuth2 login: /oauth2/authorization/{google|github|spotify}
Authenticated requests: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>

## Buyer Preferences (requires auth)
GET /api/v1/preferences/me — Get current user's ticket-shopping preferences
PUT /api/v1/preferences/me — Replace current user's ticket-shopping preferences. JSON body: {"preferredArtists": [], "preferredCategories": [], "preferredCities": [], "preferredVenues": [], "preferredSections": [], "dislikedVenues": [], "dislikedCategories": [], "maxTotalPrice": number, "maxServiceFeePercent": number, "allInPriceOnly": boolean, "accessibilityNeeds": string, "riskTolerance": "CHEAPEST|BEST_VALUE|BEST_SEATS|LOW_RISK_ONLY", "willingToWaitForPriceDrops": boolean}

## Events (public, no auth required)
GET /api/v1/events — List events with search/filter/pagination
  Query params: q, category, tags, city, dateFrom, dateTo, minPrice, maxPrice, status, sort, page, size
  Returns: {"content": [EventSummary], "page", "size", "totalElements", "totalPages"}
GET /api/v1/events/featured — Featured events list
GET /api/v1/events/{slug} — Event detail by slug
GET /api/v1/events/{slug}/listings — Active ticket listings for an event (returns full list, not paginated)
GET /api/v1/events/{slug}/sections — Section availability with pricing
GET /api/v1/events/{slug}/price-history — Price history snapshots
GET /api/v1/events/{slug}/predicted-price — AI price prediction (requires AI profile)

## Categories (public)
GET /api/v1/categories — List all event categories

## Venues (public)
GET /api/v1/venues — List all venues
GET /api/v1/venues/{slug} — Venue detail by slug

## Search (public)
GET /api/v1/search?q={query} — Full-text event search
GET /api/v1/search/suggest?q={query} — Search suggestions/autocomplete

## Spotify (public, requires spotify profile)
GET /api/v1/spotify/artists/{spotifyArtistId} — Artist metadata, genres, follower count

## AI Features (requires AI provider profile)
POST /api/v1/chat — Chat with AI assistant. JSON body: {"message": "string", "conversationId": number}
GET /api/v1/recommendations — AI-ranked event recommendations. Response includes preferenceContext when stored buyer preferences are available.
GET /api/v1/events/{slug}/predicted-price — AI price prediction

## Cart (requires auth)
GET /api/v1/cart — Get current cart
POST /api/v1/cart/items — Add listing to cart. JSON body: {"listingId": number}
DELETE /api/v1/cart/items/{itemId} — Remove item from cart
DELETE /api/v1/cart — Clear cart

## Favorites (requires auth)
GET /api/v1/favorites — List favorited events
POST /api/v1/favorites/{eventId} — Add event to favorites
DELETE /api/v1/favorites/{eventId} — Remove event from favorites
GET /api/v1/favorites/check/{eventId} — Check if event is favorited

## Seller Listings (requires auth)
POST /api/v1/listings — Create a listing. JSON body: {"eventSlug", "sectionName", "rowLabel", "seatNumber", "price"}
GET /api/v1/my/listings — List seller's own listings. Query param: status (ACTIVE|SOLD|CANCELLED)
PUT /api/v1/listings/{id}/price — Update listing price. JSON body: {"price": number}
DELETE /api/v1/listings/{id} — Deactivate a listing (sets status CANCELLED, returns ticket to available)
GET /api/v1/my/owned-tickets — Tickets from confirmed orders available to relist. Returns: [{ticketId, eventSlug, eventName, eventDate, venueName, sectionName, rowLabel, seatNumber, ticketType, faceValue}]
GET /api/v1/my/earnings — Seller earnings summary with recent sales

## Checkout (requires auth)
POST /api/v1/orders/checkout — Create order from cart. JSON body: {"paymentMethod": "mock"|"stripe"}. Optional header: Idempotency-Key

## Orders (requires auth)
GET /api/v1/orders — List user's orders (paginated)
GET /api/v1/orders/{orderNumber} — Order detail
GET /api/v1/orders/{orderNumber}/calendar — Download .ics calendar file for event
GET /api/v1/orders/{orderNumber}/agent-evidence — Owner/admin-scoped agent purchase evidence trail: mandate, approval, scoped payment credential, checkout, risk, eval, actor timeline, and fulfillment artifacts

## Ticket Download (requires auth)
GET /api/v1/orders/{orderNumber}/tickets/{ticketId}/download — Download ticket PDF with QR code

## Public Ticket View (no auth — token-authenticated)
GET /api/v1/tickets/view?token={orderViewToken} — View order tickets with QR codes (mobile-optimized)
GET /api/v1/tickets/{orderNumber}/{ticketId}/qr?token={orderViewToken} — QR code PNG image

## Ticket Verification (public, no auth)
GET /api/v1/tickets/verify?token={jwt} — Verify ticket QR code token
  Returns: {"valid", "orderNumber", "ticketId", "eventSlug", "sectionName", "rowLabel", "seatNumber", "alreadyScanned", "scannedAt", "message"}

## Payments (requires auth except webhook)
POST /api/v1/payments/create-intent — Create payment intent. JSON body: {"orderNumber": "string"}
POST /api/v1/payments/confirm — Confirm payment. JSON body: {"paymentIntentId": "string"}
POST /api/v1/payments/webhook — Stripe webhook (no auth, signature verified)

## Error Format
All errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details:
{"type", "title", "status", "detail", "instance"}

## Evaluation Conditions
MockHub implements evaluation conditions (sanity checks) on AI services and MCP tool actions.
Deterministic checks verify domain invariants (event in future, listing active, price plausible).
AI-as-judge checks verify response grounding (no fabricated events, prices, or dates).
AgentRiskCondition reads persisted local risk signals for the user/agent pair.
Eval results are logged for observability. Critical eval failures may block agent actions, including repeated mandate mismatches.

## MCP Tools (OAuth 2.1 authentication)
MockHub exposes MCP tools for AI agents at /mcp (Streamable HTTP transport).
Authentication: OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration (DCR). Discovery endpoints:
- /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp — MCP resource metadata (points to the authorization server)
- /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server — authorization server metadata (issuer, token, authorize, jwks, registration)
- /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/mcp — RFC 8414 path-suffixed alias of the above (301 redirect)
DCR endpoint: POST /connect/register. Clients register automatically.
Compatible clients: Claude (desktop/web/mobile), Cursor, MCP Inspector, any OAuth 2.1 MCP client.
Sessions are in-memory — after server redeploys, clients must re-initialize.
- searchEvents(query?, category?, city?, page?, size?) — search and filter events with pagination
- getEventDetail(slug) — full event details by URL slug
- getEventListings(slug, page?, size?) — active listings for an event with pagination (default 20, max 50) plus the event commercePolicy
- getFeaturedEvents() — curated featured events
- getListingDetail(listingId) — single listing by ID, including commercePolicyUrl
- findTickets(query?, category?, city?, dateFrom?, dateTo?, minPrice?, maxPrice?, section?, maxResults?, userEmail?) — RECOMMENDED: compound search returning matching listings sorted by price, including commercePolicyUrl for each listing. Date params are ISO-8601 strings (e.g. '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z'). If userEmail is supplied, stored buyer preferences may fill missing city/category/section/maxPrice filters and return preferenceContext metadata. Reduces round-trips from 3 to 1.
- compareTickets(query?, category?, city?, dateFrom?, dateTo?, minPrice?, maxPrice?, section?, preferredSection?, maxResults?, userEmail?) — compare matching listings for agent shopping decisions. Returns ranked options, cheapest/best-value/best-section/lowest-risk picks, deterministic reason codes, rationale, and price plausibility warnings. If userEmail is supplied, stored buyer preferences may fill missing search filters/preferredSection and return preferenceContext metadata. Objective listing data is separate from heuristic judgment fields.
- getCommercePolicy(eventSlug) — structured commerce policy for agent purchase decisions (refunds, cancellations, transfer, fees, support)
- getPriceHistory(eventSlug) — historical price snapshots
- getPricePrediction(eventSlug) — AI price forecast (requires AI provider)
- getCart(userEmail) — current cart contents
- addToCart(userEmail, listingId, agentId, mandateId) — add listing to cart (eval-gated). Returns full updated cart, so a separate getCart call is not needed. May include agent-risk warnings.
- removeFromCart(userEmail, itemId) — remove cart item
- clearCart(userEmail) — empty cart
- refreshCart(userEmail) — reset cart 15-minute TTL without modifying contents
- checkout(userEmail, paymentMethod, agentId, mandateId) — create order from cart. paymentMethod must be exactly "mock" or "stripe"; use "mock" for MockHub's built-in mock-payment flow. May include agent-risk warnings.
- confirmOrder(userEmail, orderNumber, agentId, mandateId, paymentIntentId?, paymentCredentialId?, approvalId?) — complete payment; non-mock payments require paymentIntentId. Optional paymentCredentialId validates scoped payment authority before payment. Optional approvalId links the purchase to an approved audit record. May include agent-risk warnings.
- getOrder(userEmail, orderNumber) — order details
- listOrders(userEmail, page?, size?) — order history with pagination
- getCalendarEntry(userEmail, orderNumber) — RFC 5545 .ics calendar content for a confirmed order
- proposePurchase(userEmail, agentId, mandateId, proposedOrderSnapshot, agentRationale?, subtotal, serviceFee, total, commercePolicySnapshot?, expiresAt?) — create a durable purchase proposal audit record before user approval. Approval and denial are HUMAN-ONLY actions performed on the MockHub website (/my/approvals); there is deliberately no MCP tool for them, so an agent cannot approve its own proposal.
- listPurchaseApprovals(userEmail) — list purchase proposals, approvals, denials, and outcomes
- createMandate(agentId, userEmail, scope, maxSpendPerTransaction?, maxSpendTotal?, allowedCategories?, allowedEvents?, allowedSections?, approvalMode?, expiresAt?) — authorize agent actions
- revokeMandate(mandateId) — revoke agent authorization
- listMandates(userEmail) — list active mandates
- validateMandate(agentId, userEmail, scope, amount?, categorySlug?, eventSlug?, sectionName?) — check if action is authorized by scope, spending limits, and category/event/section restrictions
- getBestMandate(agentId, userEmail, eventSlug, categorySlug?, amount?, sectionName?) — RECOMMENDED before addToCart: finds the best matching mandate for a purchase action in one call
- issuePaymentCredential(userEmail, agentId, maxAmount, currency?, usage?, backingPaymentMethod?, expiresAt?) — issue a scoped mock-backed payment credential for an agent. Defaults: currency=USD, usage=ONE_TIME, backingPaymentMethod=mock.
- listPaymentCredentials(userEmail) — list active, consumed, revoked, and expired scoped payment credentials for a user
- revokePaymentCredential(userEmail, credentialId) — revoke an active payment credential so it can no longer authorize payment
- getAgentRiskSummary(userEmail, agentId) — get deterministic local risk summary for a user/agent pair, including recent signals, warning reasons, highest severity, and blocked status
- getAgentPurchaseEvidence(userEmail, orderNumber) — get the read-only evidence trail for an agent-initiated order owned by the user

## ACP Endpoints (Agentic Commerce Protocol, requires API key: X-API-Key header)
ACP-compatible checkout endpoints at /acp/v1/:
POST /acp/v1/checkout — Create checkout. JSON body: {"buyerEmail", "lineItems": [{"listingId", "quantity"}], "agentId", "mandateId", "paymentMethod": "mock"|"stripe", "idempotencyKey"}. If omitted, paymentMethod defaults to "mock".
GET /acp/v1/checkout/{checkoutId} — Get checkout status. Header: X-Buyer-Email
PUT /acp/v1/checkout/{checkoutId} — Update checkout (PENDING only). JSON body: {"agentId", "mandateId", "addItems", "removeListingIds"}. Header: X-Buyer-Email
POST /acp/v1/checkout/{checkoutId}/complete — Complete checkout. JSON body: {"agentId", "mandateId", "paymentIntentId", "approvalId", "paymentCredentialId"}. Header: X-Buyer-Email
POST /acp/v1/checkout/{checkoutId}/cancel — Cancel checkout. JSON body: {"agentId", "mandateId"}. Header: X-Buyer-Email
GET /acp/v1/catalog — Browse product catalog. Query params: query, category, city, page, size
GET /acp/v1/listings — Browse actionable ticket offers. Query params: query, category, city, dateFrom, dateTo, minPrice, maxPrice, section, page, size

## Commerce Policies
GET /api/v1/commerce/policies/default — Default agent-readable commerce policy
GET /api/v1/commerce/policies/events/{eventSlug} — Event-scoped commerce policy
Policy fields: policyId, version, eventSlug, policyUrl, updatedAt, sections[], supportContact, supportUrl.
ACP catalog items, ACP listing items, ACP checkout responses, and MCP getEventListings include commercePolicy directly.
MCP findTickets, compareTickets, and getListingDetail include commercePolicyUrl for each actionable listing.

## Agent Mandates

Mandates define what an agent is authorized to do on behalf of a user.
Scope: BROWSE (read-only) or PURCHASE (can buy, subsumes BROWSE).
Limits: per-transaction max, cumulative total budget, category/event/section restrictions, expiration.
Approval mode: AUTO_PURCHASE allows direct completion; APPROVAL_REQUIRED requires an approved purchase approval before completion.
Autonomous purchase actions require both agent identity and mandate proof.
Managed via MCP MandateTools or directly via mandate service.

## Scoped Payment Credentials

Payment credentials are separate from mandates. A mandate proves the agent may act; a payment credential proves the agent may pay with a scoped mock-backed instrument.
Fields: credentialId, userEmail, agentId, allowedMerchant=MOCKHUB, maxAmount, currency=USD, usage=ONE_TIME|REUSABLE, status=ACTIVE|CONSUMED|REVOKED|EXPIRED, backingPaymentMethod=mock, expiresAt.
MCP `confirmOrder` and ACP `completeCheckout` accept optional `paymentCredentialId`. When supplied, MockHub validates user, agent, amount, currency, payment method, status, and expiration before payment confirmation, then consumes one-time credentials for the order number.

## Buyer Preference Memory

Buyer preferences store explicit ticket-shopping preferences separately from inferred Spotify/favorites signals.
Fields include preferred artists/categories/cities/venues/sections, disliked venues/categories, max all-in price, max service fee tolerance, all-in price preference, accessibility needs, risk tolerance, and willingness to wait for price drops.
Authenticated users manage preferences with `GET/PUT /api/v1/preferences/me`.
MCP `findTickets` and `compareTickets` can accept `userEmail` to apply stored preferences and return `preferenceContext` metadata showing which filters or ranking hints were applied.
AI recommendations include explicit preferences in the prompt when present and expose preferenceContext without exposing raw Spotify listening data.

## Agent Risk Signals

Agent risk signals are deterministic local records for agent shopping behavior. They are not an external fraud score.
Signals include cart hold attempts, rapid cart holds, checkout attempts, mandate mismatches, failed checkouts, high-spend attempts, payment-credential failures, and risk-condition blocks.
AgentRiskCondition blocks repeated mandate mismatches as CRITICAL. Repeated failed checkouts, rapid cart holds, and high-spend attempts produce WARNING signals.
MCP agents can call `getAgentRiskSummary(userEmail, agentId)` before or after a purchase flow.

## Agent Purchase Evidence

Agent purchase evidence is a read-only assembled record for a single order. It includes order/cart line items, mandate scope and budget, purchase approval state when present, scoped payment credential status and consumption, ACP-aligned checkout status, risk signals, derived eval outcomes, actor timeline entries, and ticket fulfillment artifacts.
Use REST `GET /api/v1/orders/{orderNumber}/agent-evidence` as the authenticated owner/admin endpoint or MCP `getAgentPurchaseEvidence(userEmail, orderNumber)` for agent self-inspection.
Email/SMS provider delivery receipts are not persisted; the evidence record marks those dispatch fields as not persisted instead of inventing provider IDs.

### Mandate Lifecycle

1. Create — User grants agent a mandate via createMandate tool. Defines scope, spending limits, allowed categories/events/sections, approval mode, and optional expiration.
2. Validate — Every agent purchase action (addToCart, checkout, confirmOrder) triggers MandateCondition (CRITICAL severity). Checks: mandate active, not expired, scope covers action, within spending limits, allowed category/event/section.
3. Spend Tracking — On order confirmation, the order total is recorded against the mandate's cumulative spend (totalSpent). Remaining budget = maxSpendTotal - totalSpent.
4. Spend Reversal — If a confirmed order is cancelled via cancelOrder, the order total is reversed (subtracted from totalSpent), restoring available budget.
5. Revoke — User revokes mandate via revokeMandate tool. Status set to REVOKED. Subsequent agent actions using this mandate are blocked.

### Purchase Flow with Mandates

findTickets(query, filters) → getBestMandate(agentId, userEmail, eventSlug, categorySlug?, amount?, sectionName?) → addToCart(userEmail, listingId, agentId, mandateId) → checkout(userEmail, paymentMethod="mock", agentId, mandateId) → confirmOrder(userEmail, orderNumber, agentId, mandateId)

Each step validates the mandate via eval conditions. Spend is recorded on confirmation. If the order is later cancelled, spend is reversed.

### Eval Conditions

- MandateCondition (CRITICAL): Blocks actions without a valid mandate. Checks scope, per-transaction and cumulative spending limits, category/event/section restrictions.
- SpendingLimitCondition (WARNING): Advisory alert when cart total exceeds $2000 (configurable). Does not block — mandate per-transaction limits are the hard stop.
- AgentRiskCondition (WARNING/CRITICAL): Warns on recent risk reasons and blocks repeated mandate mismatches for the same user/agent pair.

## Content Types
Request: application/json
Response: application/json
